utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the date, time, and repair list for the drive? I want to make sure I have the details right before I help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I still don’t have the date, time, or repair list yet, but I can bring a couple of tools once you’ve got them set.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — just send me the repair list when you have it, and I’ll keep track of what we still need.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll send the repair list over as soon as I have it, and I’ll keep passing along any updates too.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’m still gathering the latest on the repair drive, but I’ll pass it along as soon as I know more.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Tess — if you can still bring a couple extra tools, that’d be really helpful for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Oh good, I can bring those. Anything else you still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right, I still need to pin down the date and time, and the repair list too. I’m sorry, I keep misplacing my toolbox, but I’ll check what’s left right now.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Leo — I’ll keep an ear out too and let you know if I hear any updates about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — just let me know if you need me for anything.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh hey, I may have missed a few updates, but last I heard they were still collecting stuff for the repair drive. I don’t know the full list yet.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Can you confirm what we still need for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, that’d be great—thanks. If you hear anything new, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I will—I'm still trying to pin down exactly what supplies and hands we’re short on for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — send me the updated spot and timing when you have it, and I’ll bring the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — it’s Sunday at the community center, and I’ll send the exact address as soon as I have it. Appreciate you bringing the toolbox.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Any update on the date, time, and repair list yet?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I don’t have the date and time yet, but I can help sort the donations and label the boxes once we’ve got the repair list.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo — if you could bring tools and a bit of tape, that would help. I’m still waiting on the date, time, and repair list, but I’ll let you know as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear what we still need for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I’m still trying to get the latest list together for the repair drive. If you’ve heard any updates, I’d really appreciate them.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m still waiting on a clear start time and list, Rey. Once you have that, I’ll bring whatever’s needed.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m still waiting on the latest, but I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands and let you know if I hear anything about the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Vik — I’ve got it as the community center on Sunday, and I’ll keep track until Rosa sends the address.
